title: Tenant User-JWT observability and Growth Control runtime wiring

phases.objective: Parse the canonical mixed-auth principal before tenant-only membership and scope guards on observability and Growth Control Plane routes, while retaining fail-closed User-JWT-only tenant authority and committing the generator-produced frontend dispatch evidence for the same source tree.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Bearer User JWT request to tenant observability or Growth Control Plane
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The canonical authentication parser populates req.auth before the tenant guard, active membership remains authoritative, non-tenant principals or invalid scope fail closed without secret or cross-tenant leakage, and the generated frontend dispatch artifact describes the same guard chain.
steps: Enter the tenant observability or Growth Control Plane route with an Authorization Bearer token.
Run the canonical mixed-auth parser before the tenant-only scope guard.
Require user_jwt mode and resolve active membership from authoritative tenant state.
Execute only the tenant-safe projection after principal and tenant scope are established.
Generate the frontend surface dispatch artifact through the governed generator and commit its exact source digest/guard-chain evidence.
Exercise regressions that verify parser-before-guard ordering and preserve existing OpenAPI/auth contracts.
assertions: Tenant observability invokes the injected canonical authentication middleware before requireTenantObservabilityPrincipal.
Tenant Growth Control Plane invokes the injected canonical authentication middleware before requireTenantUserJwt.
The tenant guards still require user_jwt mode and active tenant membership after parsing.
Admin/backend-only identity is not silently converted into tenant identity.
The committed frontend-surface-dispatch generated artifact is produced by the repository generator and is covered by this E2E contract.
No credential value, authorization header, provider payload, database mutation, migration, Production mutation, deployment, external send, or secret is produced by this repair.
